Case Studies / Stainless Steel Name Tags

Published August 13, 2026

Steel tag project

Stainless steel name tags for uniforms, offices and equipment labels.

A buyer needed stainless steel name tags that could work across staff identification and small equipment labeling, with clean engraving and consistent brushed metal finish.

Request Similar QuoteView Stainless Steel TagsContact on WhatsApp

Project need

The buying problem behind this order.

The project needed a durable silver-tone tag with readable text, flexible mounting and a finish that looked consistent across different applications.

The quote process focused on artwork clarity, size, material, finish, mounting method, packing, MOQ and production timing. These are the details most B2B buyers should prepare before sampling.

  • Product type: stainless steel name tags and engraved steel badges.
  • Material: stainless steel, aluminum or plated metal.
  • Finish: brushed stainless steel, polished steel, engraving, black fill or digital print.
  • Mounting: magnetic back, pin back, screw holes, adhesive backing or custom slots.
  • MOQ: typical starting quantity is 100 pieces per design.
  • Timing: about 7 days for sample and about 15 days for bulk production after approval.

Manufacturing decisions

Key decisions before sampling.

These decisions affect price, sample accuracy and repeat production consistency.

Surface Choice

Brushed stainless steel was selected for a clean silver look with reduced glare.

Mounting Split

Uniform tags used magnetic backs, while equipment labels used adhesive backing or holes.

Data Control

Names, titles and serial fields were checked before engraving to avoid rework.

Information needed for a similar project.

FAQ

Stainless Steel Name Tags case questions.

Can stainless steel name tags be used for uniforms?

Yes. Magnetic backing can be used for uniforms, while holes or adhesive backing can be used for equipment.

Can stainless steel tags include serial numbers?

Yes. Serial numbers, QR codes and model fields can be engraved or printed.

What artwork files are accepted?

PDF, PSD, AI and clear image files can be reviewed before production artwork is prepared.
